scripts.deploy:frontend: npm run replace:env && firebase deploy && git checkout -- frontend
scripts.deploy:sonic: hardhat compile && hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network sonic
scripts.deploy:local: hardhat compile && hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network localhost
scripts.symlink:dmc: mkdir -p frontend/src/abis && ln -sf "$PWD/artifacts/contracts/mock/DMC.sol/DMC.json" frontend/src/abis/DMC.json && ln -sf "$PWD/artifacts/contracts/mock/DMC.sol/DMC.dbg.json" frontend/src/abis/DMC.db.json
